description: Edit the logged-in account's bio (the text under the name on the profile). Own account only; changing bio links is not supported (app-only). Other profile fields are left untouched. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

bio.description: The new bio text. Pass an empty string to clear it.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

name: profile_update
title: Profile update
